import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] num11 = new long[20];
    static long[] pow10 = new long[20];
    static int answer = -1;

    static void initialize() {
        pow10[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 17; i++) {
            pow10[i] = pow10[i - 1] * 10;
        }
        num11[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 17; i++) {
            num11[i] = num11[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }
    }

    static int lengthOf(long x) {
        int length = 0;
        do {
            length++;
            x /= 10;
        } while (x != 0);
        return length;
    }

    static void search(int pos, long x, int cnt) {
        if (answer != -1 && cnt >= answer)
            return;
        if (x == 0 || pos == 0) {
            if (answer == -1 || cnt < answer)
                answer = cnt;
            return;
        }
        if (x < 0)
            x = -x;

        long temp_x = x;
        int temp_cnt = 0;
        while (temp_x >= pow10[pos - 1]) {
            temp_x -= num11[pos];
            temp_cnt += pos;
        }
        search(pos - 1, temp_x, cnt + temp_cnt);

        temp_x = num11[pos + 1] - x;
        temp_cnt = 0;
        while (temp_x >= pow10[pos - 1]) {
            temp_x -= num11[pos];
            temp_cnt += pos;
        }
        search(pos - 1, temp_x, cnt + pos + 1 + temp_cnt);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        initialize();

        long x = sc.nextLong();
        answer = -1;
        int len = lengthOf(x);
        search(len, x, 0);
        System.out.println(answer);
        sc.close();
    }
}
